Git attributes for generated, binary, and protobuf files.

# Purpose
This `.gitattributes` content marks generated files and fixture data so Git and GitHub treat them as non-source content. It disables diff display for generated code and binary data under paths such as `src/disco/gui/dist_*/**/*`, `src/flamenco/types/fd_types_reflect_generated.c`, `contrib/test/test-vectors-fixtures/**`, `src/flamenco/types/fixtures/**`, `*.pb.h`, `*.pb.c`, and `corpus/**`, and it sets `linguist-generated` for the generated file groups.
